description: This file contains utility functions and constants for handling session keys in a routing context, including normalization, classification, and building session key strings for agent sessions, peer sessions, and thread sessions.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Trims and lowercases the input string, handling null or undefined values.

methods.name: scopedHeartbeatWakeOptions
methods.description: Adds sessionKey to wakeOptions if parseAgentSessionKey returns a truthy value.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes the main key string, defaulting to 'main' if input is empty.

methods.name: toAgentRequestSessionKey
methods.description: Converts a store key to an agent request session key, parsing if possible.

methods.name: toAgentStoreSessionKey
methods.description: Builds a session key string for storing agent session data based on provided parameters.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the agent ID from a session key.

methods.name: classifySessionKeyShape
methods.description: Classifies the shape of a session key as 'missing', 'agent', 'malformed_agent', or 'legacy_or_alias'.

methods.name: normalizeAgentId
methods.description: Normalizes an agent ID string, ensuring it is path-safe and shell-friendly.

methods.name: isValidAgentId
methods.description: Checks if an agent ID string is valid according to the regex.

methods.name: sanitizeAgentId
methods.description: Returns a normalized agent ID string.

methods.name: buildAgentMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a main session key string for an agent.

methods.name: buildAgentPeerSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string for a peer, supporting various scopes and link resolution.

methods.name: resolveLinkedPeerId
methods.description: Resolves a linked peer ID based on identity links, channel, and peer ID.

methods.name: buildGroupHistoryKey
methods.description: Builds a group or channel history key based on channel, account ID, peer kind, and peer ID.

methods.name: resolveThreadSessionKeys
methods.description: Resolves session keys for threads, optionally normalizing thread IDs and appending suffixes.
